title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Leadership and Organizational Behaviour
description: The course explains the complexities and dynamism involved in understanding and managing organizational processes and structures.
longDescription: What is Leadership and organizational behaviour? Understanding of Leadership Competencies. Why is self-awareness important in leadership? Different traditional and contemporary leadership theories. Understanding of different fundamental leadership skills like Self-awareness, Communication, Influence, and learning agility. The working of Leadership and management together in organizations. The course explains the complexities and dynamism involved in understanding and managing organizational processes and structures. This course aims to provide learners with a foundational understanding of leadership and organizational behaviour. By the end of the module, learners will have gained the knowledge and skills required to understand the concept of leadership, identify leadership competencies, explain the importance of self-awareness in leadership, differentiate between traditional and contemporary leadership theories, and develop fundamental leadership skills.
